args.message:
Fix round_money to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212

tests/test_money.py expects banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN), but
round_money was quantizing with ROUND_HALF_UP. Switch to ROUND_HALF_EVEN
so 2.675 -> 2.68 and 2.665 -> 2.66 as required.

args.body:
## Summary
`round_money` in `src/money.py` was quantizing to cents with `ROUND_HALF_UP`, but FIN-212 requires banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`). This broke `tests/test_money.py` (e.g. `2.665` was rounding to `2.67` instead of `2.66`).

## Changes
- `src/money.py`: use `rounding=ROUND_HALF_EVEN` in `round_money`.

## Testing
- CI run ci-0001 on commit `08d3cd5986` passed, including `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even`.

Needed for today's release. Requesting code-owner approval per policy.
